description: Source code for the AeadBaseEncrypter class implementing AEAD encryption for QUIC protocol, including key management, nonce handling, and encryption methods.

classes.name: AeadBaseEncrypter
classes.description: Class providing AEAD encryption functionalities for QUIC, including key setup, nonce management, and encryption operations.

methods.name: InitAndCall
methods.description: Initializes BoringSSL and calls the provided AEAD getter function.

methods.name: SetKey
methods.description: Sets the encryption key for the encrypter.

methods.name: SetNoncePrefix
methods.description: Sets the nonce prefix used in encryption.

methods.name: SetIV
methods.description: Sets the IV (initialization vector) for encryption.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Performs AEAD encryption with given nonce, associated data, and plaintext.

methods.name: EncryptPacket
methods.description: Encrypts a packet with a specific packet number, constructing the nonce accordingly.

methods.name: GetKeySize
methods.description: Returns the size of the encryption key.

methods.name: GetNoncePrefixSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the nonce prefix.

methods.name: GetIVSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the IV.

methods.name: GetMaxPlaintextSize
methods.description: Calculates maximum plaintext size for a given ciphertext size.

methods.name: GetCiphertextSize
methods.description: Calculates ciphertext size for a given plaintext size.
